about_the_game:
When Meteors fall from the sky and destroy your town you take matters into your own hands ... literally! This 1-hour game will send you soaring through the skies and features:

  • Storytelling

  • 12 Levels

  • 1 Boss Fight

  • 4 Upgradable attributes

  • A Cannon

Be the Ammunition!

Load yourself into a cannon and fire yourself into the sky. Get up close and personal and punch the meteors in the face! Meteors have faces, right? Doesn't matter! Nothing stops a go-getter like you!

Do the Government's Job!

If there's one thing we can all agree on, it's that if you want something done right you gotta do it yourself! But the fact that the government will pay you for doing their job for them is a nice bonus! 

Upgrade Your Abilities!

Spend all that money you earned on yourself! You deserve it! You can inexplicably increase your power using the money the government is giving you.

Find the Source of the Meteor Strike

Why are meteors suddenly falling from the sky and destroying everything? Why does destroying them make you feel tingling? Why am I asking you these questions? You can't answer back. It's up to you to find out! I'm sure there's a perfectly rational explanation...

The Sky is the Limit

Can you max out your level? How many meteors can you break? How high can that cannon shoot you? Challenge yourself to be the best! Or not ... I'm not your boss.
